# Paris Walking Tours

> > Comprehensive guide to Paris walking tours, historical landmarks, museums, and arrondissement-by-arrondissement exploration of the city's cultural heritage.

Paris Walking Tours offers detailed guides to Paris's most significant monuments, museums, and neighborhoods, from Notre Dame and Versailles to the Marais and Latin Quarter. The site combines historical context spanning Roman times through Napoleon III with practical walking tour itineraries and interactive arrondissement maps.

## Key Topics

- Paris arrondissements
- Notre Dame cathedral
- Versailles palace
- Marais district
- Latin Quarter
- Seine River
- Napoleon III era
- Louis XIV
- Victor Hugo
- Hemingway literary Paris
- Place des Vosges
- Left Bank
- Medieval Paris history
- Impressionist art
- French Revolution sites

## Walking Tours & Itineraries

- [Notre Dame](http://paris-walking-tours.com/notredame.html): Notre Dame cathedral's Gothic architecture & medieval history
- [A Walk Around Place des Vosges](http://paris-walking-tours.com/awalkaroundplacedesvosges.html): Walking tour from Place de la Bastille to Place des Vosges
- [Versailles Tours](http://paris-walking-tours.com/versailles-tours.html): Day trips to Chateau of Versailles and Louis XIV's palace
- [Hemingway in Paris Tour](http://paris-walking-tours.com/hemingwayinparistour.html): Literary tour of Ernest Hemingway's 1920s Lost Generation Paris

## Museums & Cultural Sites

- [Museum of the Army](http://paris-walking-tours.com/museumofthearmy.html): Musée de l'Armée at Les Invalides with Napoleonic military collections
- [The Carnavalet Museum](http://paris-walking-tours.com/thecarnavaletmuseum.html): Paris history museum in Marais from Celtic to modern times
- [Maison Victor Hugo](http://paris-walking-tours.com/maisonvictorhugo.html): Victor Hugo's museum at Place des Vosges in 4th arrondissement
- [Museum of Sculpture in Open Air](http://paris-walking-tours.com/museumofsculptureinopenair.html): Open-air sculpture garden on Quai Saint Bernard in 5th arrondissement
- [Madeleine](http://paris-walking-tours.com/madeleine.html): Neoclassical Madeleine church in 8th arrondissement, Napoleon era

## Gardens & Parks

- [Jardin de l'Intendant](http://paris-walking-tours.com/jardindelintendant.html): Formal French garden at Hôtel des Invalides with Eglise du Dôme
- [Jardin Atlantique](http://paris-walking-tours.com/jardinatlantique.html): Rooftop garden above Gare Montparnasse with maritime theme

## Paris History & Culture

- [Paris History The Middle Ages](http://paris-walking-tours.com/parishistorythemiddleages.html): Medieval Paris history covering Carolingian & Capetian dynasties
- [Carolingian Dynasty](http://paris-walking-tours.com/carolingiandynasty.html): Frankish history from Charles Martel through Charlemagne's reign
- [Medieval Art](http://paris-walking-tours.com/medievalart.html): Medieval religious art history & church patronage overview
- [Gustave Caillibotte](http://paris-walking-tours.com/gustave-caillibotte.html): Impressionist painter Gustave Caillebotte's life & artistic legacy

## Arrondissement Maps

- [Paris Map 5th Arrondissement](http://paris-walking-tours.com/paris-map-5th-arrondissement.html): Searchable map of 5th arrondissement featuring Latin Quarter & Seine River
- [Paris Map 16th arrondissement](http://paris-walking-tours.com/paris-map-16th-arrondissement.html): Searchable Google Maps view of 16th arrondissement district

## Optional

- [Paris Discount hotels](http://paris-walking-tours.com/parisdiscounthotels.html): Budget hotel listings including Prince De Galles & Claridge Bellman
- [April in Paris--A Wedding Story](http://paris-walking-tours.com/april-in-parisa-wedding-story.html): Personal narrative of 1970s hippie wedding & Paris renewal ceremony
- [Comments for April in Paris--A Wedding Story](http://paris-walking-tours.com/april-in-parisa-wedding-story-comments.html): User comments and testimonials on Paris wedding story
